subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- September 06, 2026
body:
AcreetionOS‑Xlibre now builds cleanly after Darren (cobra3282000) merged a fix that untangled the geocode‑glib version clash blocking the nightly ISO. The change drops the conflicting dependency and pins the library to the version supplied by Arch’s core repo, letting the CI pipeline finish without manual intervention.

Development  
The merge request “fix geocode‑glib update conflict in AcreetionOS‑Xlibre” landed on the release‑1 branch, restoring the automated build flow for the lightweight Xlibre variant. Users tracking the rolling release will see the updated ISO appear on the download page within the next build cycle, and the changelog notes the exact package versions involved. This resolves the hiccup that had delayed the September‑5 test images and keeps the project on schedule for the upcoming 1.1 feature freeze.

Community  
Upstream Grml rolled out version 2026.09 (code‑named “Hä”) today, bringing a refreshed set of rescue tools and an updated kernel that many AcreetionOS users rely on for system recovery. The release is already mirrored on our community‑run archive, so you can pull the latest Grml ISO directly from the same mirrors that host our own images. Discord chatter shows excitement about the new Zstd‑compressed squashfs option, which promises faster boot times on older hardware.

Tip of the day  
If you’re building custom Xlibre images locally, remember to add the firefox‑ublock‑origin package to your package list before running the Calamares‑based installer. The package was just re‑added to the Xlibre meta‑group after a brief omission, and it ensures the browser ships with ad‑and‑tracker blocking out‑of‑the‑box. A quick `sudo pacman -S firefox-ublock-origin` followed by a rebuild of your profile will keep your browsing experience both private and snappy.  

For more details, see the full changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html, grab the latest ISO from https://acreetionos.org/flash.html, or dive into the wiki page on Xlibre customization at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html.
